804:         # The F4 alert clock is independent of the next permitted query. It
805:         # consumes durable failure facts, never creates fresh broker proof.
806:         key = f"protect_evidence_failure:{row['position_id']}"
807:         raw = self.store.control(key)
808:         if raw is None:
809:             return
810:         try:
811:             state = json.loads(raw)
812:             since = datetime.fromisoformat(state["since"])
813:             if since.tzinfo is None or since > now or not isinstance(state["paged"], bool):
814:                 raise ValueError("invalid evidence failure clock")
815:         except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
816:             self._protection_page(now, "P0", "evidence incomplete", row,
817:                                   "持久证据失败计时无法核实")
818:             return
819:         elapsed = (now - since).total_seconds()
820:         if elapsed >= self.cfg.protection.evidence_fail_p0_seconds and not state["paged"]:
821:             self._protection_page(now, "P0", "evidence incomplete", row,
822:                                   f"持仓、工作单、执行三项证据查询已连续失败 {elapsed:.1f} 秒")
823:             state["paged"] = True

859:         """An execution for a SELL we had already settled (the cancel -> fill
860:         race). Any retry sized from the old quantity could now oversell, so
861:         every other working SELL of the position is pulled at once and will be
862:         re-planned from the corrected quantity. Entries stop until reviewed."""

864:         with self.store.tx():
865:             self.store.raise_anomaly(now, code, f"{fill.symbol} {fill.quantity} sold by {intent['purpose']} "
866:                                                 f"after it was settled {intent['status']}")
867:         pulled = []
868:         for other in self.store.active_intents_for_position(intent["position_id"]):
869:             if other["side"] == Side.SELL and other["purpose"] != Purpose.PROTECT \
870:                     and other["intent_id"] != intent["intent_id"] \
871:                     and not other["hold_reason"]:

873:                 self._enqueue(f"cancel:{iid}", lambda iid=iid: self._request_cancel(
